source.title: Northern Ireland Assembly election, 28 June 1973: North Antrim count spreadsheet (as73-North-Antrim.xls)
source.check: all 15 stages transcribed from the spreadsheet; first preferences sum to the 71,249 valid votes, every stage balances with the non-transferable papers, and the quota of 8,907 is the valid vote divided by eight, plus one
notes: Full names as Wikipedia's North Antrim (Assembly constituency) page gives them (from the EONI 1973 results); ARK prints surnames and initials. ARK prints "Wilson, A." where Wikipedia has Hugh Wilson, and "Turnly" where its own stage heading and Wikipedia have Turnley.
Wikipedia gives Ian Paisley 14,553 first preferences; ARK's 14,533 is the figure that adds up to the valid poll.
Labels as printed (Off. Un., D. U. Loy. Coal., V. U. Loy. Coal., All. Party, S.D.L.P., N.I.L.P.) filed as UUP, DUP, Vanguard, Alliance, SDLP and NI Labour, as in the other 1973 contests.
